AI Notes.value: Isabel Okoro: Nigerian, Toronto-based visual artist and photographer (born Lagos 2001, moved to Toronto 2016). Practice centers on an imagined world Eternity and the concept normatopia; book Friends in Eternity. Gallery-represented and collected (Olga Korper Gallery, Patel Brown, Art Gallery of Ontario), widely featured (Dazed, It is Nice That, Atmos). Co-founder and Creative Director of creative studio local global (archiving African diaspora stories via visual art, sound, programming); also DJs. Young but already exhibiting and running a studio, so a strong independent autonomy: Autonomy 4 (hedged on commercial-direction experience). Work Status Freelance (independent artist running her own studio; no outside employer). IG @isabelokoro verified (bio references Eternity and @localglobal.world).
